instruction: You are facing an open door.  You are going to turn to your left.  And you are going to go down the hallway.  And right past a picture on the wall of a flower on the left will be an open door.  You are going to enter that door on your left.  And you are going to walk straight across into this room passing a sink area on your left.  And you are going to stop right in front of the toilet on the black rug and you are done.
